content.title: Gap's Wells Fargo upgrade, Navan stock falls on earnings & CFO news
content.description:
As US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) fall following new labor market data, Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton examines some of the top stories on Wall Street in Tuesday's Market Minute.

Wells Fargo analysts upgraded Gap Inc. (GAP), while Navan (NAVN) stock is falling after the company's earnings release and news that CFO Amy Butte is leaving the company.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
